traditions.LXX: καὶ ὡς ὄρνεα τὰ θηρευόμενα ἐν παγίδι ,
traditions.VUL: et sicut aves láqueo comprehendúntur ,
traditions.KJV: and as the birds that are caught in the snare ;

12.english_reference: so [ are ] the sons of men snared in an evil time ,

traditions.WLC: כָּ הֵ֗ם יֽוּקָשִׁים֙ בְּנֵ֣י הָֽ אָדָ֔ם לְ עֵ֣ת רָעָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: ὡς αὐτὰ παγιδεύονται οἱ υἱοὶ τοῦ ἀνθρώπου εἰς καιρὸν πονηρόν ,
traditions.VUL: sic capiúntur hómines in témpore malo ,
traditions.KJV: so [ are ] the sons of men snared in an evil time ,

12.english_reference: when it falleth suddenly upon them .

traditions.WLC: כְּ שֶׁ תִּפּ֥וֹל עֲלֵי הֶ֖ם פִּתְאֹֽם
traditions.LXX: ὅταν ἐπιπέσῃ ἐπ᾽ αὐτοὺς ἄφνω .
traditions.VUL: cum eis extémplo supervénerit .
traditions.KJV: when it falleth suddenly upon them .

13.english_reference: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun ,

traditions.WLC: גַּם זֹ֛ה רָאִ֥יתִי חָכְמָ֖ה תַּ֣חַת הַ שָּׁ֑מֶשׁ
traditions.LXX: Καί γε τοῦτο ἴδον σοφίαν ὑπὸ τὸν ἥλιον ,
traditions.VUL: Hanc quoque sub sole vidi sapiéntiam ,
traditions.KJV: This wisdom have I seen also under the sun ,

13.english_reference: and it [ seemed ] great unto me :

traditions.WLC: וּ גְדוֹלָ֥ה הִ֖יא אֵלָֽ י
traditions.LXX: καὶ μεγάλη ἐστὶν πρὸς μέ .
traditions.VUL: et probávi máximam :
traditions.KJV: and it [ seemed ] great unto me :

14.english_reference: [ There was ] a little city , and few men within it ;

traditions.WLC: עִ֣יר קְטַנָּ֔ה וַ אֲנָשִׁ֥ים בָּ֖ הּ מְעָ֑ט
traditions.LXX: πόλις μικρὰ καὶ ἄνδρες ἐν αὐτῇ ὀλίγοι ,
traditions.VUL: cívitas parva , et pauci in ea viri :
traditions.KJV: [ There was ] a little city , and few men within it ;

14.english_reference: and there came a great king against it , and besieged it ,

traditions.WLC: וּ בָֽא אֵלֶ֜י הָ מֶ֤לֶךְ גָּדוֹל֙ וְ סָבַ֣ב אֹתָ֔ הּ
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἔλθῃ ἐπ᾽ αὐτὴν βασιλεὺς μέγας καὶ κυκλώσῃ αὐτὴν
traditions.VUL: venit contra eam rex magnus , et vallávit eam ,
traditions.KJV: and there came a great king against it , and besieged it ,

14.english_reference: and built great bulwarks against it :

traditions.WLC: וּ בָנָ֥ה עָלֶ֖י הָ מְצוֹדִ֥ים גְּדֹלִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἰκοδομήσῃ ἐπ᾽ αὐτὴν χάρακας μεγάλους ,
traditions.VUL: exstruxítque munitiónes per gyrum , et perfécta est obsídio .
traditions.KJV: and built great bulwarks against it :

15.english_reference: Now there was found in it a poor wise man ,

traditions.WLC: וּ מָ֣צָא בָ֗ הּ אִ֤ישׁ מִסְכֵּן֙ חָכָ֔ם
traditions.LXX: καὶ εὕρῃ ἐν αὐτῇ ἄνδρα πένητα σοφόν ,
traditions.VUL: Inventúsque est in ea vir pauper et sápiens ,
traditions.KJV: Now there was found in it a poor wise man ,

15.english_reference: and he by his wisdom delivered the city ;

traditions.WLC: וּ מִלַּט ה֥וּא אֶת הָ עִ֖יר בְּ חָכְמָת֑ וֹ
traditions.LXX: καὶ διασώσῃ αὐτὸς τὴν πόλιν ἐν τῇ σοφίᾳ αὐτοῦ ,
traditions.VUL: et liberávit urbem per sapiéntiam suam :
traditions.KJV: and he by his wisdom delivered the city ;

15.english_reference: yet no man remembered that same poor man .

traditions.WLC: וְ אָדָם֙ לֹ֣א זָכַ֔ר אֶת הָ אִ֥ישׁ הַ מִּסְכֵּ֖ן הַ הּֽוּא
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἄνθρωπος οὐκ ἐμνήσθη σὺν τοῦ ἀνδρὸς τοῦ πένητος ἐκείνου .
traditions.VUL: et nullus deínceps recordátus est hóminis illíus páuperis .
traditions.KJV: yet no man remembered that same poor man .

16.english_reference: Then said I , Wisdom [ is ] better than strength :

traditions.WLC: וְ אָמַ֣רְתִּי אָ֔נִי טוֹבָ֥ה חָכְמָ֖ה מִ גְּבוּרָ֑ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ εἶπα ἐγώ Ἀγαθὴ σοφία ὑπὲρ δύναμιν ·
traditions.VUL: Et dicébam ego , meliórem esse sapiéntiam fortitúdine :
traditions.KJV: Then said I , Wisdom [ is ] better than strength :

16.english_reference: nevertheless the poor man ’s wisdom [ is ] despised ,

traditions.WLC: וְ חָכְמַ֤ת הַ מִּסְכֵּן֙ בְּזוּיָ֔ה
traditions.LXX: καὶ σοφία τοῦ πένητος ἐξουδενωμένη ,
traditions.VUL: quómodo ergo sapiéntia páuperis contémpta est ,
traditions.KJV: nevertheless the poor man ’s wisdom [ is ] despised ,

16.english_reference: and his words are not heard .

traditions.WLC: וּ דְבָרָ֖י ו אֵינָ֥ ם נִשְׁמָעִֽים
traditions.LXX: καὶ οἱ λόγοι αὐτοῦ οὐκ εἰσακουόμενοι ,
traditions.VUL: et verba eius non sunt audíta ?
traditions.KJV: and his words are not heard .

17.english_reference: The words of wise [ men are ] heard in quiet

traditions.WLC: דִּבְרֵ֣י חֲכָמִ֔ים בְּ נַ֖חַת נִשְׁמָעִ֑ים
traditions.LXX: Λόγοι σοφῶν ἐν ἀναπαύσει ἀκούονται
traditions.VUL: Verba sapiéntium audiúntur in siléntio ,
traditions.KJV: The words of wise [ men are ] heard in quiet

17.english_reference: more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools .

traditions.WLC: מִ זַּעֲקַ֥ת מוֹשֵׁ֖ל בַּ כְּסִילִֽים
traditions.LXX: ὑπὲρ κραυγὴν ἐξουσιαζόντων ἐν ἀφροσύναις .
traditions.VUL: plus quam clamor príncipis inter stultos .
traditions.KJV: more than the cry of him that ruleth among fools .

18.english_reference: Wisdom [ is ] better than weapons of war :

traditions.WLC: טוֹבָ֥ה חָכְמָ֖ה מִ כְּלֵ֣י קְרָ֑ב
traditions.LXX: ἀγαθὴ σοφία ὑπὲρ σκεύη πολέμου ,
traditions.VUL: Mélior est sapiéntia , quam arma béllica :
traditions.KJV: Wisdom [ is ] better than weapons of war :

18.english_reference: but one sinner destroyeth much good .

traditions.WLC: וְ חוֹטֶ֣א אֶחָ֔ד יְאַבֵּ֥ד טוֹבָ֥ה הַרְבֵּֽה
traditions.LXX: καὶ ἁμαρτάνων εἷς ἀπολέσει ἀγαθωσύνην πολλήν .
traditions.VUL: et qui in uno peccáverit , multa bona perdet .
traditions.KJV: but one sinner destroyeth much good .
